verdict.rationale: Rippling markets 'Ask Rippling AI anything across all your data' plus AI-driven surfacing of device/threat/compliance answers and automated remediations, indicating built-in AI-generated insights within the product. However, evidence is entirely first-party marketing copy with no independent/hands-on corroboration, and details on how insights are surfaced (UI, scope, accuracy) are thin. Missing for 10: independent verification of the 'Ask Rippling AI' feature in practice, concrete examples of generated insights/suggestions, and detail on coverage beyond device/compliance domains.
